source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion: Enter duplicates with reported failures by year. 3. Enter failed inspection records. 4. Keep only failed test records (delete passes). When to Run #4: In one or more years * New or updated test: data can be added to the model at any time to be reflected in your local analysis/report. * Missing water test results: municipalities can consult the Model to confirm that any data from your municipality is reflected in the model. * * If missing data from previous years is found, and not provided to the Model yet, it can be given to the Model. * If missing data from the current year is found, submit it to the DWQR as per their requirements. Missing sample results are reflected in the model. * Updated map: the map is updated on the last working day of every month
